SUBJECT: A.S.Migulina, an undesirable element.

1) Name : Migulina, Anna Semenovna
2) Nationality : Russian emigress
3) Address : 446 Rue Bourget
4) Passport No : 8493
5) Date of issue : 1-5-39 (not valid )
6) Place " " : Shanghai
7) Date of birth : 15-2-1900
8) Place " " : Orenburg
9) Profession : Teacher ( drawing)
10) Family :
Daughters : 1) Lubov, born on the 18-6-20
2) Ludmila, " " " 1-9-23
Sister : Evdokia Semenovna Gunn, British
subject, residing at 342 Rue
Bourget, tel. No 71581

Character:
A.S.Migulina came to, the notice of Police
in connection with her failure to obtain residents cer-
tificate. On being quistioned by the undersigned she
stated that the " Pao Chia census form" was handed over
by her to Yulin Rd. St. 4 months ago and that her fai-
lure to obtain the registration certificates was cau-
sed by her sickness( according to her she was confined
to bed for a considerable time, after being bitten
by a rabid dog.)
In the course of enquiries it was revealed
that the whole of the family are degrading persons
of low reputation. The rent for the house at 446 Bai-
kal Rd. has not been paid for 5 months. Mother is known
as a habitual drunkard, and the two daughters were un-
til recently working in the cabarets. The junior dau-
ghter-Ludmila has a daughter named Alla ,1½ years old
born out of wedlock from an American marine named
A.Reinnard. They are friquently visited by different
men, who are indulging with them in drinking and are
creating disturbances by singing and shouting. It is
reported that daughters are earning money by prosti-
tution.
At present the whole family, though registered
as living at 446 Baikal Rd., most of the time live
at 342 Rue Bourget, with E.S.Gunn.

B.Vanhoff
D.S.

Officer i/c. Foreign Affairs
C. & S. Branch.

档案号。

主题：A.S.米古利娜，不良分子。

1) 姓名：米古利娜，安娜·谢苗诺夫娜 (Migulina, Anna Semenovna)
2) 国籍：俄国侨民
3) 地址：布尔热路 (Rue Bourget) 446号
4) 护照号码：8493
5) 签发日期：1939年5月1日（已失效）
6) 签发地点：上海
7) 出生日期：1900年2月15日
8) 出生地点：奥伦堡 (Orenburg)
9) 职业：教师（绘画）
10) 家庭成员：
女儿：1) 柳博芙 (Lubov)，生于1920年6月18日
2) 柳德米拉 (Ludmila)，生于1923年9月1日
姐妹：叶夫多基娅·谢苗诺夫娜·冈恩 (Evdokia Semenovna Gunn)，英国臣民，居住于布尔热路 (Rue Bourget) 342号，电话 71581

品行表现：
A.S.米古利娜因未能取得居住证而进入警方视线。在接受下文签署人问询时，她声称“保甲户口表”已于四个月前提交给玉林路巡捕房，并称其未能取得登记证的原因是其患病（据她称，被疯狗咬伤后，她卧床相当长一段时间）。
在调查过程中发现，该全家均为声誉低劣的堕落之人。贝加尔路 (Baikal Rd.) 446号的房屋租金已拖欠五个月。母亲素有酗酒恶名，两个女儿直至最近一直在歌舞厅工作。小女儿柳德米拉有一个名叫阿拉 (Alla) 的女儿，一岁半，系与美国海军陆战队员 A.雷纳德 (A.Reinnard) 非婚所生。常有不同男子频繁造访，与他们一起酗酒，并通过唱歌和喊叫制造骚乱。据报道，女儿们通过卖淫赚钱。
目前，尽管全家人登记居住在贝加尔路 (Baikal Rd.) 446号，但大部分时间都与 E.S.冈恩 (E.S.Gunn) 一起住在布尔热路 (Rue Bourget) 342号。

B.万霍夫 (B.Vanhoff)
副督察
